# H2ODB — Sum and Mean

```{tags} reference, query-template, h2odb
```

> [H2ODB](../../h2odb.md) benchmark · [all H2ODB queries](index.md)

SUM and AVG of fare_amount (scalar aggregation)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  SUM(fare_amount) AS sum_fare_amount,
  AVG(fare_amount) AS mean_fare_amount
FROM trips
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q2_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Q2: SUM and AVG of fare_amount."""
    trips = ctx.get_table("trips")
    col = ctx.col
    return trips.select(
        col("fare_amount").sum().alias("sum_fare_amount"),
        col("fare_amount").mean().alias("mean_fare_amount"),
    )
```
